newsitem.title: GERMANY: E.German firms see rising sales, flat profits - D&B.
newsitem.headline: E.German firms see rising sales, flat profits - D&B.

text.p: East German businesses have become more optimistic about their outlook for the second quarter, according to a survey by the Dun & Bradstreet business information company.
But despite the expected sales increases, earnings are not expected to improve, D&B said in a statement. The earnings expectations index fell by two points.

D&B said its east German index for sales expectations in the second quarter had risen by eight points to 20. The index is based on a regular survey of managers in industry, trade, construction and service sectors.
The survey reveals that the service sector is growing less confident, with companies becoming more pessimistic about their sales and earnings outlook. --Frankfurt Newsroom, +49 69 756525
